headline: U.S. Warplanes Strike Iranian Missile Site on Qeshm Island
summary: American fighter jets using precision munitions struck an Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps missile site on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz in response to regional force aggression.
why: Military escalations in the Strait of Hormuz present severe geopolitical risks to global crude oil transit routes and maritime freight.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Military strikes near the Strait of Hormuz heighten supply disruption fears in key oil transit channels.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: U.S. airstrikes on Iranian missile sites in the Strait of Hormuz heightened geopolitical tensions and stoked fears of disruptions to critical Middle Eastern oil transit corridors.
